apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: actionq-smoke-schema-migrate-v4
  namespace: vuoro-shared
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-execution-migrate
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database-migration
spec:
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 600
  backoffLimit: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-execution-migrate
        app.kubernetes.io/component: database-migration
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      restartPolicy: Never
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: migrate
          image: ${REGISTRY_IP}:5000/actionq-server:0.1.14-dd41a98@sha256:4877eb4ac9789d2e5f68abe220f926a4dadf625126502f6c099f3ccd728ff469
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["sh", "-ec"]
          args:
            - |
              ACTIONQ_URL="$MIGRATION_DSN" ACTIONQ_SCHEMA=actionq_smoke ACTIONQ_RUNTIME_ROLE=vuoro_execution_runtime actionctl migrate --json-output
              ACTIONQ_URL="$RUNTIME_DSN" ACTIONQ_SCHEMA=actionq_smoke actionctl check-compatibility
          env:
            - name: MIGRATION_DSN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-execution-migration, key: uri}
            - name: RUNTIME_DSN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-execution-runtime, key: uri}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 20m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
